title: Both local saturation checks do not prove exactness
situation: For source and recorded output both (6) in Z, saturation at 2, source containment holds and the recorded generator 6 has a saturation witness. Yet 3 lies in the saturation via 2*3=6 and not in the recorded (6).
attempted_conclusion: Promote source containment plus generator no-invention to exact saturation semantics.

expected.reason: Both local checks pass, but 3 is in (6):2^infinity and not in the unchanged output (6).
